headline: The watch clock learned to keep pace
lede: Nightly smoke was calling healthy autopilots stale — race resume gates demanded distance a throttled CI box physically couldn't cover in real time. #2036 is now fixed: the budgets scale with measured world ticks, capped so healthy boxes see zero relaxation, and blob-battle's seat finally releases honestly when its match is won.

notes.text: watchcheck resume gates for both comet racers and blob-battle no longer lose to software-Chrome tick debt — merged 31108b4 from a resumed dead-session branch.

scripts/lib/watchbudget.mjs rescales the 500-unit bar by the measured tick delta (floor 40u, cap 500u); a browser-free watchbudgetcheck pins 15 rules nightly in the static-core scope; --throttle N reproduces the bad box on demand.

Full regression surfaced 27 pre-existing boot-reds on 5 pilots this branch provably doesn't touch (start swallowed) — owned by QA as #2115/#2095. And the warden kicked two slot-a sessions that drove one branch at once: additive, no damage, but the liveness lease should block the second kick.
